metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of Picqer, the Katapull group's cloud warehouse management system for online stores and fulfilment companies: store and marketplace intake, order allocation, inventory ledger, locations, counting and batch traceability, purchasing and receiving, batch picking, packing, shipping integrations, printing and hardware, returns, rules, mobile app, collaboration and reports, multi-client fulfilment with portal and invoicing. Module-level architecture is inferred from published features, not documented by Picqer.

rootGroups.name: Order and Channel Intake
rootGroups.description: Getting orders, products and partner data into the warehouse.

bricks.name: Webshop and Marketplace Store Connectors
bricks.description: Turn-key connections that import products and orders from webshop platforms and marketplaces and push stock levels, order status and track-and-trace back. Picqer builds Magento 1/2, Shopify, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Shopware 5/6, CCV Shop and bol Retailer itself; others (e.g. Craft Commerce) are partner-built.

modules.name: Store Setup Wizard
modules.description: Connects a store in minutes, maps statuses and shipping methods, runs a first import.

modules.name: Store Connection API
modules.description: Stores credentials and mappings per store and triggers imports.

modules.name: Order Import Worker
modules.description: Polls or receives orders from each connected store and marketplace.

modules.name: Stock Push Consumer
modules.description: Pushes free stock to every connected channel when stock changes.

modules.name: Status and Tracking Write-back
modules.description: Marks orders shipped and writes the tracking code to the channel.

modules.name: Store Connection Service
modules.description: Holds connection settings, sync cursors and health per store.

modules.name: Store and Marketplace Adapters
modules.description: Adapters for Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Shopware, CCV Shop and bol Retailer APIs.

dataDependencies.description: Store credentials, mappings and sync cursors.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Webshop platforms (Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, Lightspeed, Shopware, CCV Shop)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of products and orders; target of stock and status.
Marketplace orders and shipment confirmation, including Shipping via bol.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Install Picqer from the Shopify app store (assumed listing).

bricks.name: Multi-Channel Order Management and Allocation
bricks.description: One overview of all orders from every channel, manual entry and the API; allocates stock, creates picklists per warehouse, manages backorders and partial deliveries, and lets staff pause orders with a reason.

modules.name: Order Overview
modules.description: Lists orders by status, channel and priority; manual order entry.

modules.name: Order API
modules.description: Create, update, pause and cancel orders.

modules.name: Allocation and Backorder Worker
modules.description: Allocates stock when orders or receipts arrive and releases backorders in sequence.

modules.name: Order Service
modules.description: Holds orders, lines, priorities, pause reasons and partial deliveries.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for orders in the warehouse.
Customer and delivery address of each order.

bricks.name: B2B Customer Portal
bricks.description: A mini online store on live warehouse stock for wholesalers: business customers log in, see stock and their prices, place orders and follow history and status.

modules.name: B2B Portal Web App
modules.description: Catalogue with stock, price lists, ordering and order history.

modules.name: B2B Portal BFF
modules.description: Serves catalogue, prices and orders for one business customer.

bricks.name: Picqer Public API and Webhooks
bricks.description: Public REST/JSON API with public documentation and webhooks for real-time events such as picklist status and stock changes, used by partners, custom shops, POS systems and reports.

modules.name: Public REST API
modules.description: Versioned JSON endpoints for orders, products, stock, picklists, purchase orders, returns and more.
Uses api auth and rate limit.

modules.name: API Auth and Rate Limiting
modules.description: Validates API keys and enforces limits per account.

modules.name: Webhook Subscription Service
modules.description: Stores webhook endpoints and event types per account.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.system: Partner integrations (Optiply, Rewize, Trengo, Belco, xCore/Exact Online, Itsperfect, App4Sales, Order2Flow and others)
Custom shops, POS and reporting tools

bricks.name: Katapull Commerce Hub Bridges
bricks.description: Productised connections between Picqer and Katapull sibling products. Evidenced today: DeliveryMatch (integration listed on both sites), Returnista (native returns integration); Transus and Vendit list Picqer as a partner. A Logic4 bridge is an inference from Katapull positioning Picqer as the WMS step-up for Logic4 customers.

modules.name: Hub Connection Settings
modules.description: Activates sibling connections with shared credentials.

modules.name: Hub Bridge Service
modules.description: Maps accounts and objects between Picqer and sibling products.

modules.name: Sibling Product Adapters
modules.description: Adapters for DeliveryMatch, Returnista, Logic4 (assumed), Transus (assumed) and Vendit (assumed).

brickDependencies.description: Uses the public API like other partners.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Carrier selection and labels for 200+ carriers.
Return portal; pre-registers returns in Picqer.
Orders, products and stock for Logic4 customers.

rootGroups.name: Inventory and Purchasing
rootGroups.description: Knowing what is where and buying in time.

bricks.name: Product Catalogue and Barcodes
bricks.description: Product master with images, supplier, weight, dimensions, barcodes (including GS1 with lot or expiry details) and stock settings; imported from stores or edited in bulk via Excel.

modules.name: Barcode Parser
modules.description: Recognises EAN, GS1-128, DataMatrix and QR including lot and expiry data.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for warehouse product data.

bricks.name: Inventory Ledger and Stock Sync
bricks.description: Records every stock change from zero with user and reason, tracks physical, reserved and free stock per warehouse and location, and publishes stock changes to channels and partners in real time.

modules.name: Stock and History UI
modules.description: Stock per location and full change history.

modules.name: Stock Query API
modules.description: Physical, reserved and free stock queries.

dataDependencies.description: Every stock mutation with user and reason.

bricks.name: Warehouses, Locations and Replenishment
bricks.description: Multiple warehouses in one account, pick and bulk locations, containers such as crates and carts, weekly A/B fast-mover classification, and replenishment of pick locations from bulk.

modules.name: Location Management UI
modules.description: Define warehouses, locations and location types.

modules.name: Fast-Mover Classification Job
modules.description: Weekly A/B classification of products by picks.

modules.name: Replenishment Planner
modules.description: Suggests moves from bulk to pick locations.

modules.name: Location Service
modules.description: Warehouses, locations, containers and routes order.

bricks.name: Cycle Counting
bricks.description: Counting all year round in small rounds: count everything, a risk-based selection, or only locations where something happened; differences corrected on confirmation.

modules.name: Count Selection Engine
modules.description: Selects locations by risk or activity.

bricks.name: Batch and Best-Before Traceability
bricks.description: Records batch numbers and best-before dates at receipt and tracks them through stock, moves, picks, counts and returns; shows batches in the fulfilment portal (released 2026 according to Picqer).

modules.name: Batch and Expiry Views
modules.description: Stock and shipments per batch and expiry.

modules.name: Lot Service
modules.description: Batches with expiry per location and shipment.

brickDependencies.description: Reads lot and expiry from GS1 barcodes.

dataDependencies.description: Batch and best-before data and genealogy.

bricks.name: Purchase Advice and Purchase Orders
bricks.description: Advice per supplier on what to buy based on stock, sales and waiting customers; converts advice to purchase orders e-mailed as PDF and Excel; tracks expected deliveries. Partners such as Optiply and Rewize add forecast-based advice.

modules.name: Purchasing UI
modules.description: Advice, purchase orders and expected deliveries.

modules.name: Purchase Order Mailer
modules.description: Sends purchase orders with PDF and Excel.

modules.name: Purchase Order Service
modules.description: Suppliers, purchase orders and expected dates.

bricks.name: Goods Receipt and Put-away
bricks.description: Receipt of purchase orders by scanning, into a location or a container, with several people on one receipt, product label printing and A/B hints for put-away; shows which backorders can ship.

bricks.name: Picklist and Batch Picking Engine
bricks.description: Creates picklists and batches on the optimal route, singles picking for single-line orders, bulk processing of identical orders, urgent and snoozed picklists, pausing with reasons and picklist splitting.

modules.name: Picking UI
modules.description: Picklists and batches in the browser.

modules.name: Batch Builder
modules.description: Builds batches, singles lists and bulk groups.

bricks.name: Packing Station and Packaging Advice
bricks.description: Packing table workflow with barcode verification, packaging advice based on dimensions or rules, and recording of the packaging used per shipment for cost pass-through.

modules.name: Packaging Advisor
modules.description: Recommends box or envelope from dimensions or rules.

bricks.name: Shipping Provider Integrations and Labels
bricks.description: Creates shipments and labels with carriers and shipping platforms (Picqer lists PostNL, DHL eCommerce, GLS, DPD, Sendcloud, MyParcel, Shippo, DeliveryMatch, Wuunder, MontaShip and more), stores tracking codes and e-mails customers with track-and-trace.

modules.name: Shipped Notification Consumer
modules.description: Sends shipment e-mails and triggers channel write-back.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Carriers (PostNL, DHL eCommerce, GLS, DPD, Budbee, Cycloon and others)
Shipping platforms (Sendcloud, MyParcel, Shippo, DeliveryMatch, Wuunder, QLS, MontaShip and others)

bricks.name: Automatic Printing and Warehouse Hardware Connectivity
bricks.description: Sends labels and packing slips straight to printers without print dialogs and connects scanners, carton sealers and label applicators, conveyors and goods-to-person systems (Kardex, AutoStore) with hardware partners.

modules.name: Printer and Device Settings
modules.description: Register printers and devices per station.

modules.name: Print Agent (assumed local client)
modules.description: Receives print jobs at the warehouse and prints silently.

modules.name: Print Job Service
modules.description: Queues label and document print jobs per station.

modules.name: Mechanisation Adapters
modules.description: Interfaces with conveyors, carton machines and goods-to-person systems via partners.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Goods-to-person and conveyor systems (Kardex, AutoStore) via intralogistics partners

bricks.name: Returns Processing
bricks.description: Registers returns manually or pre-registered by return tools (Returnista, Returnless, ReturnGO), scans returned parcels, records inspection and restocks sellable items.

rootGroups.name: Automation, Mobile and Insight
rootGroups.description: Making the team faster and informed.

bricks.name: Rules Automation Engine
bricks.description: If-this-then-that rules evaluated on every new order and picklist: choose a shipping method, mark urgent, snooze until a date, assign to a user or zone, add packaging or notes, per product, destination, weight or fulfilment client.

bricks.name: Picqer Mobile App
bricks.description: iOS and Android app for handheld scanners and phones: batch picking, receiving, counting, moving and replenishing stock, tasks and comments, included in all plans.

modules.name: Picqer App
modules.description: Native app for handhelds (e.g. Zebra TC22).

modules.name: Mobile BFF
modules.description: Aggregates picking, stock and task endpoints for the app.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Apple App Store and Google Play

bricks.name: Comments, Tasks and Notifications
bricks.description: Comments with @mentions, reactions and up to five photos on picklists, orders and purchase orders, warehouse tasks, a "For you" inbox and e-mail notifications, shared with fulfilment clients.

bricks.name: Reports and Warehouse Analytics
bricks.description: Warehouse status at a glance and reports on team performance, stock levels, bestsellers and slow movers, also available to fulfilment clients.

bricks.name: Fulfilment Client Separation
bricks.description: Keeps every fulfilment client's products, stock and orders separate inside one account, while the floor processes all clients through one workflow with client-specific settings and rules.

modules.name: Fulfilment Client Service
modules.description: Client accounts and scoping of data.

bricks.name: Fulfilment Client Portal
bricks.description: Portal in the 3PL's branding where clients see stock and orders in real time, import products, push stock, create (concept) orders, cancel unpicked items, release partial deliveries, use purchase advice and pull reports, with rights per client.

bricks.name: Fulfilment Client Invoicing
bricks.description: Connects each client's rates to picklists, shipments, receipts, returns, packaging and storage to build invoice lines by category; announced by Picqer as in development (October 2026).

modules.name: Invoice Line Builder
modules.description: Builds monthly invoice lines per client.

bricks.name: Accounts, Users and Rights
bricks.description: Multi-tenant accounts with unlimited users, per-user rights, copying users, a rights overview and logins for portal users.

bricks.name: Plans, Trials and Order-Volume Billing
bricks.description: Self-service 14-day trial, plan selection (Team, Business, Premium, Premium+, Enterprise; Fulfilment, Plus, Next, Max), order counting against included volume and per-order fees, payment by card or SEPA direct debit.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Payment provider (card and SEPA direct debit)
